article.title: Los Angeles plays Utah for conference showdown
article.linkText: Los Angeles plays Utah for conference showdown
article.story: Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, first in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-1, eighth in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Sunday, 5 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles heads to Utah for a Western Conference matchup. Utah finished 22-60 overall, 12-40 in Western Conference games and 14-27 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Jazz averaged 29.6 assists per game on 42.5 made field goals last season. Los Angeles finished 53-29 overall and 33-19 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Lakers averaged 116.3 points per game while shooting 50.2% from the field and 35.9% from deep last season. INJURIES: Jazz: Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot). Lakers: Cameron Carr: day to day (oblique), Adou Thiero: day to day (knee), Jake LaRavia: day to day (ankle). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
